articleBatch.title: Use your free credits
articleBatch.loadFailed: The overview could not be loaded.
articleBatch.disabledTitle: Available on plans with AI articles
articleBatch.disabledDescription: Upgrade your plan to have Topiqu write articles for you.
articleBatch.rolloverCapTitle: Your carried credits have reached the limit
articleBatch.rolloverCapDescription: Unused credits from this period will not carry over. Using them now keeps them from lapsing.

free.label: Free credits
free.info: Available credits minus what the autopilot is expected to use in the next 30 days. This is an estimate.

surplus.label: Unused every month
surplus.info: How many credits of your monthly allowance the autopilot does not use at its current rhythm and quality. This is an estimate.

quality.title: {level} quality
quality.description: You still publish {articles} article a month, in higher quality, and use {credits} of your {allowance} credits. | You still publish {articles} articles a month, in higher quality, and use {credits} of your {allowance} credits.

tempo.title: Faster autopilot
tempo.description: About {articles} article a month instead of {current}. | About {articles} articles a month instead of {current}.
tempo.confirmMessage: The autopilot will write about {articles} articles a month and use credits accordingly. You can change this any time in settings.

plan.title: Article plan
plan.description: We propose topics, you approve them and the articles get written on their own. The proposal is free.
plan.noPermission: Starting a plan requires permission to use AI and edit other authors’ articles.
plan.proposeUpTo: Propose up to {n} article | Propose up to {n} articles

proposal.proposing: Looking for more topics. You can already edit the list.
proposal.fewer: We found only {n} strong topic. The other credits stay available for later. | We found only {n} strong topics. The other credits stay available for later.
proposal.weakNote: Topics we are less sure about are not selected. Tick the ones you want written.
proposal.modeLegend: What should happen with the articles?
proposal.duration: The plan will take about {days} days.
proposal.fastPace: This is a fast pace. Publishing many articles at once can look unnatural to search engines and readers.
proposal.overFree: This plan also uses credits the autopilot is expected to need. The autopilot may run out sooner.
proposal.approve: Approve {n} article for {credits} credits | Approve {n} articles for {credits} credits
proposal.approved: The plan is approved. You can close this page.

SPREAD.label: Write and publish gradually
SPREAD.description: Each article is written shortly before its date and published if it passes the same checks as the autopilot. Others wait for you.
SPREAD.unavailable: Requires publishing on your Topiqu blog and permission to publish.

DRAFTS.label: Write now as drafts
DRAFTS.description: All articles are written one after another, and you review and publish them yourself.

progress.label: Plan progress
progress.cancelTitle: Cancel the rest of the plan?
progress.cancelMessage: Articles not yet started will not be written and their credits stay yours. An article being written will still finish and be charged.

paused.credits: The plan is waiting for credits. It continues on its own once you have enough.
paused.allowance: Writing is temporarily paused. The plan continues on its own.
paused.access: The person who approved this plan can no longer run it. Resume it to continue under your account.
paused.failures: Several articles in a row failed, so the plan is paused. We will try again tomorrow, or you can resume it now.

errors.generic: That did not work. Please try again.
errors.ACTIVE: A plan is already running. Wait for it to finish or cancel it first.
errors.NO_CREDITS: You have no credits to plan with right now.
errors.NO_PROFILE: Tell us what your blog is about first, so the proposed topics fit it.
errors.NO_WEB_PUBLISHING: Gradual publishing requires publishing on your Topiqu blog.
errors.EMPTY: The selected topics are no longer available. Propose articles again.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS: You do not have enough credits for this many articles. Remove some of them.

notifications.cancelled: Your article plan was cancelled because your plan no longer includes AI articles.
notifications.finished: Your article plan is finished: {written} written, {held} to review, {failed} failed.

paused.credits: Your article plan is waiting for credits.
paused.allowance: Your article plan is temporarily paused and will continue on its own.
paused.access: Your article plan is paused because its approver can no longer run it.
paused.failures: Your article plan is paused after several failed articles.

nudge.title: You have {n} free credits
nudge.description: Topiqu can propose how to use them. You only approve.
